statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-31, the Hamas disarmament agreement announced by the Gaza Board of Peace will produce a verified weapons handover or destruction event under third-party or press observation.
resolution: True if the Gaza Board of Peace or a major wire service (Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, BBC) reports a verified Hamas weapons handover or destruction event under this agreement between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-31; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-14, Iran or Iran-aligned forces will conduct at least one additional strike on a vessel or a US-linked asset in the Gulf states or the Strait of Hormuz.
resolution: True if U.S. Central Command or a major wire service (Reuters, AP, CNBC) reports a new Iran-linked strike on a vessel or Gulf-state US asset between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-14; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-21, Anthropic will publish a public postmortem or security advisory specifically addressing the reported Claude-related breach of three organizations and the PyPI malware upload.
resolution: True if Anthropic publishes a blog post, security advisory, or report specifically addressing this incident, as reported by a major outlet, between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-21; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-19, the confirmed death toll among migrants crossing the Spain-Morocco border at Ceuta during this surge will exceed 60.
resolution: True if Spanish authorities or a major wire service (Reuters, AP) reports a confirmed death toll above 60 from this border-crossing surge between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-19; otherwise false.

statement: Apple stock will record at least one additional daily close lower than its 2026-07-31 close on any trading day between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-07.
resolution: True if Apple common stock closes below its 2026-07-31 close on at least one trading day between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-07; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-10-30, the Federal Reserve will announce an increase in the federal funds rate.
resolution: True if the Federal Reserve announces an increase in the federal funds rate, as reported by a major financial outlet, between 2026-07-31 and 2026-10-30; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-28, at least one additional named individual will publicly allege misconduct against the St Paul mayor, or the mayor will resign or face a formal ethics or criminal proceeding.
resolution: True if a major outlet reports a new named accuser, a resignation, or a formal ethics or criminal proceeding involving the St Paul mayor between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-28; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-24, the combined confirmed death toll from the current Greece and Spain wildfire events will exceed 5.
resolution: True if Greek or Spanish civil protection authorities or a major wire service reports a combined confirmed death toll above 5 from these wildfire events between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-24; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-18, Houthi forces and Saudi Arabia will exchange at least one additional publicly reported military strike, beyond the current flare-up in Yemen.
resolution: True if a major wire service (Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera) or Deutsche Welle reports a new Houthi-Saudi strike or attack in Yemen between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-18; otherwise false.
